使い方なんて解らない。

pages.en:
—I cannot defeat this Servant.

With my one free hand, I have no choice but to summon the only force that can defeat her: Saber.

I do not know how to use a Command Spell.

But I have done it once. If I truly will it, there is no reason I cannot do it again…!
pages.mirrorMoon:
I can’t match this Servant.
Then I should use my free hand and call for the one who can beat her!
I don’t know how to use it.
But I’ve used it before, so there’s no way I wouldn’t be able to now…!

pages.en:
“Come to me, Saberrrrrr—!”

Light covers my vision.

Perhaps from the Command Spell’s activation, a savage pain tears through my left hand.

Splash. A rushing pour.

The sound of flowing blood. Pain—and a still greater agony from my left hand.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“PLEASE COME, SABER!!”
My field of vision is filled with light.
It might be the effect of the Command Spell as I feel pain in my left hand.
I hear the splashing of blood.
I feel pain from my left hand.

“Ah—gah, ah, aaaaaaaaah…………!!!!”

My throat howls of its own accord.

As though the organs of speech no longer belong to me, they do nothing but scream of the unbearable pain.

“Ah, hia, ah, ahhhhhhh…!!!!!”
An unconscious howl escapes my throat.
My vocal organs appeal to me about the pain.

上出来です。左手だけを自由に動かせるようにすれば、必ず令呪に頼る。
先ほど色々と囀っていましたが、追い詰めれば貴方も他のマスターと変わらない。令呪によってサーヴァントを律するだけの人間です」

pages.en:
“—Excellent. By leaving only your left hand free, I knew I could force you to rely upon a Command Spell.

“You chirped so very bravely before, but once cornered, you are no different from any other Master: merely a human who controls a Servant through Command Spells.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Well done. You were bound to use your Command Spell if I kept your left hand free.
You were twittering nonsense before, but you are no different from other Masters once I’ve cornered you. You are only a person who binds the Servant using your Command Spell.”

“Ah—gh, ah, hah…………!”

…It will not stop.

The blood pouring from my left arm will not stop.

How could it, with everything beyond the elbow gone and a bucket-sized opening left behind…!?

“Ahkuh, ah, ahh…!”
It won’t stop.
The blood coming out of my left arm won’t stop.
There’s no way it’ll stop if there’s a wound this big…!

pages.en:
“To make you use a Command Spell—that was the condition I imposed upon myself for this hunt, and now it has been satisfied.

“Only one task remains: gouging out your eyes. …But I shall forgive you that. Your cries of agony have satisfied me more than enough. If I were to pluck out your eyeballs as well, I would unquestionably reach climax.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“To make you use your Command SpellI have fulfilled the condition I set for myself.
And the other thing would be to gouge your eyes out… But I shall spare you from that. You have fulfilled me enough with your voice of anguish. I will orgasm if I gouge your eyes out as well.”

—The blood will not stop.

Consciousness drifts farther away.

Before that—before I really d— from blood loss—the Command Spell, Saber, I have to—

pages.en:
“You have lost quite enough blood. …Ordinarily I would hollow out your chest and finish you, but in recognition of your valiant struggle, I shall refrain.

“Archer’s Master will arrive shortly. If fortune favors you, you may survive—but even if you do, your brain will never function properly again.”

but I shall restrain myself since you have put up a good fight.
Archer’s Master should be here soon. You shall survive if you are luckybut your brain will not function even if you are saved.”

The blood continues to drain from me as I hang in the air.

Saber. I said—I wouldn’t call Saber—
